Below is one valid 15‐day itinerary that uses exactly six direct “flight‐days” (i.e. overlaps) so that each city’s required number of days is met and all special day constraints hold. In this plan you start in Vienna (where you must be on Day 1 and Day 4 for the conference), then fly on a day counted in both cities, and so on. One working order of the seven cities is:

1. Vienna for 4 days  
2. Rome for 3 days  
3. Riga for 2 days  
4. Vilnius for 4 days  
5. Milan for 2 days  
6. Lisbon for 3 days  
7. Oslo for 3 days

When laid out with overlaps the day ranges are computed as follows. (Remember that when you leave a city on a “flight‐day” that day is counted as the last day in the departing city and as the first day in the arriving city.) 

• Block 1: In Vienna you are from Day 1 through Day 4. (Thus you satisfy the conference requirement on Day 1 and Day 4.)  
• Block 2: You fly from Vienna to Rome on Day 4; you then spend 3 days in Rome—that is Days 4, 5, and 6.  
• Block 3: Next you catch a direct flight from Rome to Riga on Day 6 (the “from Rome to Riga” flight is available). Riga is visited on Days 6 and 7.  
• Block 4: On Day 7 you fly from Riga to Vilnius (note the available “from Riga to Vilnius” flight) and then enjoy Vilnius for 4 days: Days 7, 8, 9, and 10.  
• Block 5: On Day 10 you take a direct flight from Vilnius to Milan (since “Vilnius and Milan” is on the list) so that Milan is “visited” on Days 10 and 11.  
• Block 6: On Day 11 you fly from Milan to Lisbon (the “Milan and Lisbon” connection exists) and enjoy Lisbon for 3 days. This means you are in Lisbon on Days 11, 12, and 13—which places your visit to your relatives between Day 11 and Day 13.  
• Block 7: Finally, on Day 13 you fly from Lisbon to Oslo (allowed by “Lisbon and Oslo”). You then spend 3 days in Oslo: Days 13, 14, and 15. This ensures you meet your friend in Oslo sometime between Day 13 and Day 15.

A check of the direct flights shows:  
• Vienna → Rome (“Vienna and Rome”)  
• Rome → Riga (“from Rome to Riga”)  
• Riga → Vilnius (“from Riga to Vilnius”)  
• Vilnius → Milan (“Vilnius and Milan”)  
• Milan → Lisbon (“Milan and Lisbon”)  
• Lisbon → Oslo (“Lisbon and Oslo”)

All required city durations are met (Vienna 4, Rome 3, Riga 2, Vilnius 4, Milan 2, Lisbon 3, Oslo 3) and the special requirements (conference days in Vienna; visiting relatives in Lisbon between Days 11–13; meeting a friend in Oslo between Days 13–15) are also satisfied.

{
  "itinerary": [
    {"day_range": "Day 1-4", "place": "Vienna"},
    {"day_range": "Day 4-6", "place": "Rome"},
    {"day_range": "Day 6-7", "place": "Riga"},
    {"day_range": "Day 7-10", "place": "Vilnius"},
    {"day_range": "Day 10-11", "place": "Milan"},
    {"day_range": "Day 11-13", "place": "Lisbon"},
    {"day_range": "Day 13-15", "place": "Oslo"}
  ]
}

You can follow this itinerary knowing that on every flight day you count for both the origin and destination and that every direct flight connection in the order is available.
